verdict.rationale: Zero is an AI email client with an inbox chat assistant, so letting users plug in external MCP servers is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence only documents the opposite role: Zero exposes its own MCP server (ZeroMCP) for email tools. Nothing shows Zero acting as an MCP client that connects to third-party MCP servers, so the server-side evidence earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
